THE 157TH PSI UPSILON CONVENTION
The Hotel Syracuse, Radisson Plaza
Syracuse, New York
June 23-26, 2000
Brothers from across North America will meet in Syracuse, New York for Psi Upsilon's 157th Convention and
2000 Leadership Institute in June.
The Psi Upsilon Convention is not only the legislative arm of the
Fraternity, but it is also the entity around which Psi Upsilon is organized.
While each chapter is officially responsible for ensuring the attendance
of at least one alumnus and two undergraduate delegates, all brothers
are welcomed and encouraged to participate. Taking part in the legislative process and determining the future of your fraternity is only part of
the Convention experience. The annual Convention is a wonderful
opportunity to share in the brotherhood and camaraderie Psi Upsilon
offers.
The 156th Convention honored five chapters
with prestigous Psi Upsilon awards.There were
no nominations for the Distinguished Alumni
Service Award. All chapters are encouraged to
prepare submissions to be considered for these
awards at the 157th Convention in June 2000.
2000 Leadership Institute:The Leadership Institute offers programs in
student development, chapter management, motivation, leadership
principles and techniques. Through guest speakers and hands-on
interactive exercises, undergraduate brothers will gain the necessary
tools to become effective chapter leaders.
Undergraduate registration fees are $225 per person and alumni registration fees are $275 per person ($100/spouse).
